name: liminal-keys
description: Sign documents and files in Claude with your own certificate. Private keys stay in Liminal Keys; rules and phone approval can gate every signature. PDFs can show a visible stamp; other file types are supported too. Not made or endorsed by Anthropic.

plugins.name: liminal-keys
plugins.description: Sign documents and files in Claude with certificates held in Liminal Keys. Cryptographic signing over MCP with optional PDF/PAdES helper and visible stamp. Legal effect depends on your certificate, setup, and applicable law.
